title: A table entry contains a record prefix
statement: Let a configuration of a machine with $K$ work tapes have tape $r$ storing a table with header field $h$ and entry fields $e_0,e_1,\ldots$, and suppose this table is represented on the tape with separators between fields. Assume $h$ is nonempty, every entry has length $m$, and every field within each entry is nonempty. If the head of tape $r$ is at offset $o$ plus the starting offset of entry $e_j$, where $j$ is an entry index and $j$ is less than the number of entries, then for every positive integer $m_0\le m$, the tape stores the first $m_0$ fields of $e_j$ as a record beginning at its head, with the record's prescribed separator layout.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration $d$ with $K$ work tapes and input $x$
Entry list $es$ satisfying the table well-formedness conditions
Head position equals $o$ plus the starting offset of entry $j$
